const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboCasa-GR1 pepper-to-pan controller for the live eai-standard client.
+
+The controller uses camera calibration/depth plus the robot's own command state.
+The staged CLI lets the live operator inspect each approach before continuing.
+Run, for example, ``python /app/output/gen.py hover``.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAM = "egoview"
+DT = 0.05
+RIGHT_ROT = np.array([-1.6991082, 1.0374428, 0.8825997])
+LEFT_ROT = np.array([1.7247392, -1.5275129, 1.2608149])
+
+
+def current_action(obs):
+    layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    state = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    names = [f"cmd_{side}_{axis}" for side in ("right", "left")
+             for axis in ("x", "y", "z", "rx", "ry", "rz")]
+    names += [f"cmd_{side}_{finger}" for side in ("right", "left")
+              for finger in ("little", "ring", "middle", "index", "thumb_flexion", "thumb_rotation")]
+    return np.array([state[layout.index(name)] for name in names], dtype=float)
+
+
+def run_target(robot, target, steps=30, label=""):
+    obs0 = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CAM], include_depth=False, video="none")
+    base = current_action(obs0)
+    row = np.asarray(target, dtype=float).copy()
+    actions = np.repeat(row[None, :], int(steps), axis=0)
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="linear",
+                       cameras=[CAM, "robot0_agentview_right"], video="none", note=label)
+    d = OUT / "live"
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{label}_{cam}.png")
+    (d / f"{label}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "meta": {k: res.meta.get(k) for k in
+          ("done", "reason", "control_steps", "time_left_s")},
+          "proprio": res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[-30:]}, indent=2))
+
+
+def pose_target(action, side, xyz, rot=None, hand=None):
+    a = np.asarray(action, dtype=float).copy()
+    offset = 0 if side == "right" else 6
+    a[offset:offset + 3] = xyz
+    if rot is not None:
+        a[offset + 3:offset + 6] = rot
+    if hand is not None:
+        h = 12 if side == "right" else 18
+        a[h:h + 6] = hand
+    return a
+
+
+def main(stage):
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    print("connected", json.dumps({"protocol": spec["protocol"], "dt": spec["control_dt"],
+                                    "time_left_s": robot.status().get("time_left_s")}))
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CAM], include_depth=True, video="none")
+    action = current_action(obs)
+    if stage == "hover":
+        # Image/depth back-projection places the pepper at base-frame x=.30,y=-.17;
+        # stay about 14 cm over the board while checking the grasp approach.
+        target = pose_target(action, "right", [0.300, -0.170, 0.180])
+        run_target(robot, target, steps=36, label="hover")
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit("stage must be hover (more stages are added after inspection)")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "hover")
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
